text: Excellent professional and friendly service by the receptionists and Dentist Dr. Pimm. My husband and I had our teeth scaled and checked up for a very reasonable price and we are returning to get work on our teeth done tomorrow.

I had a very positive experience with AB Dental by IDC in Phuket. Booking an appointment was incredibly easy via WhatsApp, and I received a quick confirmation, which made the whole process very convenient.

This was already my second visit. During my first appointment, I had a night guard made and was very satisfied with the result. On my second visit, I had an X-ray and a dental cleaning.

The clinic is very professional, modern, and exceptionally clean. The dentist speaks perfect English, which made communication easy and comfortable.

What really stood out to me was the dental cleaning – unlike my experiences in Switzerland, it was completely painless.

I can highly recommend this clinic and will definitely come back again.

I had a fantastic experience today for my teeth cleaning and whitening! Dr. Apinya was professional and gentle. A big thank you to the assistants—Aon, Wawa, and Nan—for their great work, and to Pla and Rainee at the front desk for making the check-in process so smooth. My teeth look amazing! Highly recommend this team.

Professional and caring service with great communication. The visit was very efficient.

I had a check up with full X-ray and payed in total 800 bath. This is less than 20% of what it would have cost in Scandinavia. When I had questions afterwords the clinic were more than happy to consult via WhatsApp.

I flew out before I had time for a second appointment but I definitely consider coming back sometime in the future.

Highly recommend this dentist.

I’m currently on vacation in Phuket and unfortunately broke a tooth on Sunday. Not exactly what you want to experience during a holiday!

Today I went to Phuket Dental Clinic to have it checked. Even though their next available appointment was originally on Thursday, they managed to see me immediately, which I truly appreciate.

They took an X-ray first, and about 25 minutes later the entire treatment was completed — without any injection. The tooth was repaired professionally and efficiently, and I felt very well taken care of throughout the whole visit.

I’m extremely satisfied and very grateful for the quick, friendly, and professional service. Highly recommended for anyone in Phuket who needs reliable dental care, especially in urgent situations.

Thank you so much to the entire team! 🙏
Kopunkap 🙏
Excellent experience. The clinic was very clean, the team was friendly and professional, and the dentist did a great job explaining the treatment and making me feel at ease. Highly recommended.

Absolutely excellent experience. I needed a new night guard/splint as my old one broke. I reached out to this office who communicated with me in English and were able to get me an appointment very quickly. Once arriving, I was met by incredibly kind staff and a gorgeous, immaculate, high tech office. The dentist and assistants were incredibly kind and talented. The dentists English was phenomenal and she was incredibly kind. She let me know what was happening at all times. I received my nightguard/splint at the next appointment where she spent over an hour getting it perfect for me. She listened to all my thoughts and the appliance is beautifully crafted. The cost for the appliance and 3 follow up appointments is beyond fair. I fully recommend this office for any of your dental needs.
